lessons.title: Meeting Variables 📦
lessons.description: Discover what variables are, how to create them, and why they’re the backbone of scripting.

lessons.title: Working with Values & Quotes 🧾
lessons.description: Assign values, reference variables correctly, and understand quoting rules that keep your data safe.

lessons.title: Reading User Input ⌨️
lessons.description: Make interactive scripts with the `read` command – ask questions and capture answers.

lessons.title: Environment & Exported Variables 🌍
lessons.description: Learn the difference between shell and environment variables, and how to pass data to child processes.

lessons.title: Command Substitution & Arithmetic 🧮
lessons.description: Store command output in variables and perform basic maths – the first step to dynamic scripts.
